---
title: "Bad-Onestep-Good-TMLE"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(RieszCML)

set.seed(1234)

n <- 30

# Strong confounding + near positivity problems
L <- rnorm(n)
g_true <- plogis(-2 + 4 * L)
A <- rbinom(n, 1, g_true)

# True bounded outcome mean under A=1
Q_true <- plogis(-1 + 2 * L + 1.5 * A)
Y <- rbinom(n, 1, Q_true)

df <- data.frame(L = L, A = A, Y = Y)

# Deliberately bad nuisance fits:
# 1) linear probability model for Y
# 2) propensity model omitting nonlinearity / instability issues possible
rc_bad <- RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = function(data) {
    # intentionally poor outcome regression
    m_fit <- lm(Y ~ L + A, data = data)

    data1 <- data
    data1$A <- 1

    # propensity fit
    g_fit <- glm(A ~ L, family = binomial(), data = data)

    list(
      m = predict(m_fit, newdata = data),
      ma = predict(m_fit, newdata = data1),
      g = predict(g_fit, newdata = data, type = "response")
    )
  },
  alpha = ~ I(A == 1) / g,
  f = ~ m,
  h = ~ ma,
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (Y - f)
)

# One-step
est_os <- riesz_estimate(df, rc_bad)

# TMLE with bounding
est_tmle <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_bad,
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(0, 1),
  outcome_col = "Y",
  use_intercept_and_weights = FALSE
)

est_os
est_tmle
range(est_tmle$f_star)
range(est_tmle$h_star)
```


```{r, attempt 2}
n <- 400

# Strong confounding + near positivity issues
L <- rnorm(n)
g_true <- plogis(-2 + 4 * L)
A <- rbinom(n, 1, g_true)

# True bounded outcome mean under A = 1
Q_true <- plogis(-1 + 2 * L + 1.5 * A)
Y <- rbinom(n, 1, Q_true)

df <- data.frame(L = L, A = A, Y = Y)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Contrived pathological nuisance values supplied directly
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# absurdly bad current-regression f = m:
# often negative, nowhere near a valid conditional mean
m_bad <- -1.5 + 0.2 * L - 0.5 * A

# absurdly bad counterfactual regression h = ma:
# always > 1, so outside the parameter space
ma_bad <- rep(1.35, n)

# tiny treatment probabilities for treated units -> huge clever covariates
g_bad <- ifelse(A == 1, 0.02, 0.98)

rc_awful <- RieszCurve$new(
  nuis = list(
    m = m_bad,
    ma = ma_bad,
    g = g_bad
  ),
  alpha = ~ I(A == 1) / g,
  f = ~ m,
  h = ~ ma,
  ic_expr = ~ h + alpha * (Y - f)
)

# One-step
est_os <- riesz_estimate(df, rc_awful)

# Bounded TMLE
est_tmle <- riesz_tmle(
  data = df,
  rc = rc_awful,
  fluctuation = "logistic",
  bounds = c(0, 1),
  outcome_col = "Y"
)

est_os
est_tmle

range(rc_awful$fit_f)
range(rc_awful$fit_h)

range(est_tmle$f_star)
range(est_tmle$h_star)
```
